name: Spotted Towhee
desc: Spotted Towhee (Pipilo maculatus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 89 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The spotted towhee is a large New World sparrow. The taxonomy of the towhees has been debated in recent decades, and until 1995 this bird and the eastern towhee were considered a single species, then…
